## Plato quote sources

16 passages attributed to Plato in this archive, each with the locator that lets you find it in the work itself — and the one thing that most often goes wrong when people quote Plato.

[Quote source](https://www.philosophydef.com/quote-source) / Plato

How to cite this author, and what circulates under the name that is not theirs to give.

### Sourcing profile

Language of the works

Ancient Greek

Cited here from

The Republic (IV, V, VI, VII, VIII), the Symposium, the Phaedo, the Gorgias, the Theaetetus, and the Phaedrus.

How to cite it

Stephanus numbers — Republic 473c–d, Apology 38a. These are the page markers of the 1578 Geneva edition and are printed in the margin of every modern text, so they identify the passage regardless of translation or pagination.

Where quotations of this author go wrong

Socrates is a character in these dialogues and does not usually speak for Plato. The Apology is the closest thing to a record of Socrates, and even there the speech is Plato's literary composition. Attributing a dialogue's argument to Socrates as his own view is the single most common category error in this material.

1 of the passages below have been worked through against the cited edition, with the original-language wording and the circulating variants recorded on their own pages.

### Frequently asked questions

#### Where can I check quotations attributed to Plato?

Stephanus numbers — Republic 473c–d, Apology 38a. These are the page markers of the 1578 Geneva edition and are printed in the margin of every modern text, so they identify the passage regardless of translation or pagination. This archive cites Plato from The Republic (IV, V, VI, VII, VIII), the Symposium, the Phaedo, the Gorgias, the Theaetetus, and the Phaedrus. Every passage listed on this page carries that locator, so it can be found in any edition of the work.

#### What is the most common mistake when quoting Plato?

Socrates is a character in these dialogues and does not usually speak for Plato. The Apology is the closest thing to a record of Socrates, and even there the speech is Plato's literary composition. Attributing a dialogue's argument to Socrates as his own view is the single most common category error in this material.

#### What language did Plato write in?

Ancient Greek. Any English sentence you read is a translation, so a complete source names the translator as well as the passage.
